name: @papercupai/fetch-plus
description: Clean URL→markdown for agents doing web research. Wraps Jina AI Reader (https://r.jina.ai) so agents get LLM-friendly content instead of raw HTML. Handles HTML pages, PDFs, and JS-rendered sites with no install required. Optional JINA_API_KEY env var unlocks higher rate limits.
author: Papercusp

tools.name: fetch_clean
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return clean markdown stripped of boilerplate. Uses Jina AI Reader; handles HTML, PDF, and JS-rendered sites. Use this instead of OMP's `fetch` when you want LLM-ready content; use `fetch` when you need raw bytes/headers.

url.description: Absolute URL to fetch. Must be http:// or https://.

format.description: Response shape. Markdown preserves headings/links/code blocks; text is plain.

guidance.when: Read a single URL's content as clean markdown. Boilerplate-stripped, handles HTML/PDF/JS-rendered pages via Jina Reader.
guidance.notWhen: For STRUCTURED extraction (JSON shape), use `firecrawl.extract`. For crawling many pages, use `firecrawl.map` then `firecrawl.scrape` per URL.

maxResponseChars.description: Hard cap on returned content. Larger pages get truncated with a note.

userAgent.description: User-Agent header sent to Jina Reader.
